items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nat Cole was headlining, but Lee Richardson was kicking butt.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band?

Oh boy. There were some older guys in the band. They always had a singer – a male singer. There was one saxophonist, played tenor, from Harlem: Ed [?] – he didn’t continue on. He was good. Then they started getting some younger players in the band. They got a younger trombone player from New Orleans, who’s still playing. His hair is white now. He’s younger than I am. Emery Thompson, his name is. He was with the band. He wasn’t there when I joined, but I think he come in while I was there. They had a singer by the…
Let’s talk about that trip to New York. So here you’re going down to play with Luis Russell. What happens? You got to get a place to stay. You’re going to New York.
